chosen_move.description: Selected attack name from known moves when action_type is attack or suggest

emotional_state.description: Emotional state in combat (e.g. focused, combative, cautious, frightened, confident)

dialogue.description: Battle cry or tactical physical gesture

confidence.description: Confidence score for the selected tactical action

rationale.description: Tactical justification factoring type matchups, HP ratios, or knockout opportunity

suggested_alternative.description: Alternative move name suggested if questioning trainer's order
